long_biography.plain_text:
Quality certification became a practical organising principle at Sova-Plastics under Frank Somers. The Belgian mould maker subjected production processes to formal scrutiny. The company secured ISO 9001 recognition in 1992, making it one of the first injection moulders to do so. Continued certification supported a business supplying customised plastic components across several industrial markets.

Growth required repeated additions to factory space and equipment. A former neighbouring shop was cleared for expansion before a larger Tielt plant brought injection moulding, measurement and toolmaking equipment together on one site. Somers remained a director for decades as the second generation entered the business. His operating-company mandate ended in 2026, leaving the current board to family successors.
